title: Anthropic reportedly opens 34% above IPO price in Nasdaq debut
summary: Anthropic \(ticker ANT\) reportedly began trading on Nasdaq on 19 November, pricing its IPO at $83 a share and opening at $111.50, a 34% gain that implies a market value of about $1.5 trillion at the open. The offering of 980 million shares raised roughly $81.34 billion — 956.35 million new shares from the company and 23.65 million sold by existing shareholders — alongside a $26 billion concurrent private placement involving strategic investors including Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC, for a combined deal size of about $107.34 billion, according to a single CLS report reposted on Telegram and not independently confirmed.
